# 🔍 Code review checklist

## Correctness
- [ ] Change satisfies the issue/acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Edge cases, empty states, and failures are handled.
- [ ] Stable keys and predictable state flow are used.
- [ ] No unrelated behavior changes are included.

## Security and privacy
- [ ] No secrets or personal records were added.
- [ ] Public data remains safe for public disclosure.
- [ ] Inputs are validated at the boundary.
- [ ] External dependencies and asset rights are reviewed.

## Accessibility and UX
- [ ] Semantic controls and accessible names are present.
- [ ] Keyboard and focus behavior are usable.
- [ ] Reduced motion and responsive layout are considered.

## Quality and docs
- [ ] Tests added/updated.
- [ ] Lint, tests, and build run.
- [ ] Documentation and diagrams updated.
- [ ] All internal links and SVG assets validate.

## Review outcome
Approve / Request changes / Comment. Record concrete evidence and unresolved concerns.
